description:
Dataset: Puzzlebot Traffic Sign
	

This dataset was provided by Manchester University, and includes 6 sets of images of different reglamentary traffic signs of the UK. The files are compressed in dataset_traffic_sign.zip. Upon extraction, you may find the following file structure: 
data_set
  00014
    00000_00000.ppm
    00000_00001.ppm
    ...
    GT-00014.csv
  00032
  00033
  00034
  00035
  00040

Each folder contains images relative to one traffic sign class and a GT<folder>.csv… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Q-b1t/puzzlebot_traffic_signals.
